resolution.summary: Official source investigation corrects prior documentation-only conclusion. Historical commit 61429a6c1047244c91732e87b5898867853705f0, codex-rs/tui/src/voice.rs lines751-813 routes Chatgpt/ChatgptAuthTokens to POST https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/transcribe with OAuth bearer, optional ChatGPT-Account-Id, User-Agent and multipart audio.wav; API-key mode separately uses /v1/audio/transcriptions. Lines856-869 consume JSON text, not word timestamps. Removal commit 3bbc1ce00395b6b31ed5940814a2dc4cf633228f on March29 removed partially completed TUI composer transcription; this is historical evidence, not current-main behavior. Current main 6e5f665feb9b71e1500a5721036fbdb8e871f4b0 still implements RealtimeSessionMode::Transcription in codex-rs/codex-api/src/endpoint/realtime_websocket/methods_v2.rs lines145-166 with gpt-4o-mini-transcribe, with ChatGPT auth routing in model-provider-info/src/lib.rs lines426-440. Source-only files retained in .local/codex-transcription-research. Source does not establish OpenCut/account acceptance today, monthly-credit charging rules, third-party API support, or word timestamp output. No product edits, private audio upload or credential extraction/replay. Follow-up service validation needed before claiming subscription transcription is working in OpenCut.
